qualifier: from glycosylase base cleavage to gap filling
name: Base excision repair from base cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair, spanning glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines through AP-site processing and short/long-patch gap filling, which the NEIL-defect, alkylation-reversal and OGG1/MUTYH-defect confusables do not jointly cover.

name: S-phase replication initiation with intra-S damage checkpoint
rationale: Members combine DNA replication initiation and its negative regulation (with E2F1 targets) with intra-S checkpoint signalling and genome-stability maintenance, unlike confusables centred on unwinding/break-induced replication or ATR replication-stress activation.

name: Phenylalanine-tyrosine degradation and general amino acid catabolism
rationale: The specific members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism and phenylketonuria while the rest are generic amino/organic acid metabolic parent terms; confusables add tetrahydrobiopterin, glycine conjugation or other amino acids instead.

qualifier: positive regulation in NK and T cells
name: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of NK or T cell killing (including of tumour cells), whereas confusables hold NK/T signatures, degranulation and negative regulation.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
name: NADPH-supported reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
rationale: Members cover ROS/superoxide/hydroperoxide handling and redox homeostasis plus NADP(H) supply (isocitrate, NADPH regeneration, NAD transport), distinguishing it from confusables built on ascorbate, aldehyde detoxification, glutathione or ferroptosis.

qualifier: ammonia detoxification and inherited enzyme deficiencies
name: Urea cycle ammonia detoxification and its inborn errors
rationale: Members are urea cycle reactions, intermediates (citrulline, ornithine, arginine, aspartate), ammonium homeostasis and the urea cycle enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on cationic amino acid transport or glutamate/glutamine metabolism.

name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol
rationale: All members describe cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via hydroxycholesterol routes (including CYP27A1 deficiency), distinguishing it from cholesterol biosynthesis and bile acid transport/signalling confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fibre formation and matrix secretion
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis, fibril crosslinking and organisation, elastic fibre assembly and positive regulation of matrix constituent production and secretion, whereas confusables emphasise elastin catabolism, aortic development or basement membrane.

name: Polyamine metabolism, transport and eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus spermidine-dependent eIF5A hypusination and translation elongation, separating it from protein-modification, NAD/tryptophan and methionine-salvage confusables; a few members (autophagy, manganese, mitochondrial module) are peripheral.

name: Activated dendritic cell and T cell surface molecules
rationale: Members are surface signatures of activated (LPS) dendritic cells and CD4/T cells plus butyrophilin interactions, while confusables centre on monocytes and resting dendritic cells.

core: Solute carrier ion transport and its defects
name: Bicarbonate, chloride and proton exchange by SLC transporters
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26 anion exchangers, SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers with their inherited disorders, distinguishing it from CFTR/aquaporin water transport and carbonic anhydrase pH confusables.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contractility
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction and relaxation in gut motility, peristalsis, micturition and stomach function (with tachykinin signalling), unlike histamine, serotonin or reproductive smooth muscle confusables.

name: Replication stress response to fork-stalling lesions and drugs
rationale: Members address stalled replication forks: fork reversal, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink processing, camptothecin/hydroxyurea responses and intra-S checkpoint, unlike telomere maintenance, homologous recombination or DNA topology confusables.

name: Actin remodelling of filopodia, ruffles and motile protrusions
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerisation, severing, capping and bundling to build filopodia, ruffles, lamellipodia, podosomes and drive motility, whereas confusables centre on Rho GTPase cycles, Arp2/3 activation or focal adhesion complexes.

name: COPI and retrograde endosome-Golgi-ER membrane traffic
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, intra-Golgi, Golgi-to-ER and endosome/TGN-to-Golgi retrograde transport, unlike confusables directed to lysosomes or vesicle biogenesis at the TGN.

name: BDNF-TrkB signalling and postsynaptic AMPA receptor trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling to RAC1/CDK5 with endosomal trafficking and internalisation of postsynaptic AMPA/neurotransmitter receptors, while each confusable has only one of these halves.

qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
name: Notch O-glucosylation/fucosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover O-glucose/O-fucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins and ER N-glycan glucose/mannose processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose), unlike confusables on glycosaminoglycans, O-mannose, dolichol CDGs or lysosomal glycan degradation.

name: Motor coordination, locomotion and vocal learning behaviour
rationale: Members are locomotor, proprioceptive, reflex and vocal/auditory behaviours with cerebellar and striatal development, distinguished from confusables by vocal learning and voluntary movement rather than grooming, exploration or glycinergic transmission.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chains and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members combine K6/K11/K27/K29, branched and free ubiquitin chain formation and DUBs with misfolded-protein responses, ERAD regulation and degron pathways, whereas confusables lack the atypical chain types or the ERAD/misfolding arm.

name: Regulation of myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members concern myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation, differentiation and fusion into myotubes, unlike confusables on satellite cell maintenance or mature muscle fibre differentiation.

name: Nephric duct and ureter epithelial tube formation
rationale: Members are nephric duct formation, mesonephros regulation, ureter morphogenesis and epithelial tube formation, unlike confusables on nephron, ureteric bud branching or metanephros size.

name: SUMO conjugation and regulated nucleocytoplasmic protein transport
rationale: Members are SUMO processing, conjugation and target SUMOylation (including viral nucleoproteins) plus regulation of nuclear protein import/export, unlike confusables on nuclear envelope/pore assembly or PML bodies.

name: Cotranslational ER targeting, membrane insertion and retention
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent cotranslational targeting, membrane insertion and ER retention of proteins, unlike COPI/COPII vesicle traffic or ERAD confusables; Golgi vesicle fusion is a peripheral member.

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses with defective dermatan sulfate degradation
rationale: Members are Hurler, Hunter and Maroteaux-Lamy syndromes, all of which impair dermatan sulfate breakdown, unlike Sanfilippo (heparan sulfate only) and Morquio (keratan sulfate) confusables.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase regulation of synaptic endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members pair ARF and Rab GTPase signalling and TBC Rab-GAPs with endosomal synaptic vesicle recycling and receptor internalisation, unlike confusables lacking GTPase regulators or lacking the synaptic context.
